intent: A filterable catalogue of integrations: search, a category filter and one tile per provider with one action (Connect, Manage, or a disabled Connect with a Coming soon badge). Built on kit Input, SegmentedControl, Button, Badge and Empty.
useWhen: let people find and connect integrations in settings or onboarding
list providers that are coming soon
doNotUseWhen: settings for one connected integration — the integration-settings pattern
a plain list of links — LinkList

items.note: { id, name, description, category?, status: 'available'|'connected'|'comingSoon', icon? }[]

onRequest.note: Request an integration, when search finds nothing.

requirements: search is a labelled kit Input; the category filter is a kit SegmentedControl radio group
each tile action is described by the provider name
Connected and Coming soon are words, not colour alone; coming soon has a disabled Connect
Connecting is announced in a status region
tiles fade and rise in when the filter changes, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local IntegrationGrid or AppDirectory
Do not use a real provider's logo or name without labelling it an example
Do not put more than one action on a tile
snippet: <IntegrationPicker note="example providers" items={integrations} onConnect={connect} onManage={manage} connectingId={connecting} onRequest={request} />
